CommunityApplications.Profile:
An Unraid template for [Strata](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata), which runs the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model on an NVIDIA GPU plus system RAM with an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API.
The template runs Strata's official image (ghcr.io/niko1221/strata). Report template or Unraid problems in this repository's issues; report problems with Strata itself to the Strata project.
